facts.claim: Musegg Wall and nine surviving towers are part of Lucerne’s fortifications above the old town.
facts.sourceLocation: Musegg Wall and its nine towers; Construction of the Musegg Wall and towers.

facts.claim: Zyt Tower has a large clock; the city tourism page identifies it as open to the public in the visiting season.
facts.sourceLocation: The Zyt Tower: now open to the public ... features a clock.

facts.claim: The wall and towers close for winter from the beginning of November to the end of March.
facts.sourceLocation: Opening hours: From the beginning of November to the end of March, the Wall and Towers take a winter break and are closed.
